_what: The SHAPE of substrate/guild-plan.json, which is gitignored. A guild WANT is an end state — 'chest 2 should hold 300 mushrooms' — not an errand, which is what makes it safe to hand to a whole fleet: the shortfall shrinks as others contribute, nobody owns it, and a satisfied plan produces no work and no walk. Written by the planner's Guild hall sheet, read by the keeper on every town trip.
_refusals: It does nothing at all without a guild AND a hall. An unopened chest is never read as empty. Two chests cannot each be promised the whole stack. A contributor keeps its own loadout floor.
